decision.rationale: W4 de-branded the governance scripts boundary by adding GOVERNANCE_SCRIPTS_DIR, repointing the deprecated WINDSURF_SCRIPTS_DIR alias to the neutral root, and moving static scanner consumption to the neutral constant without changing scan-root parity.

spine_substrate_test.evidence: agentic_core path constants continue to provide a generic governance scripts root rather than an app-specific capability.

any_app_capability_test.evidence: No apps_* capability, product behavior, or app-owned policy was added to agentic_core.

app_owned_meaning_test.evidence: The edit is a repository governance path boundary change; app-owned meaning remains outside core.

no_app_literal_test.evidence: Touched core files introduce only .codex/governance/scripts and GOVERNANCE_SCRIPTS_DIR, with no app-specific literals.

plugin_test.evidence: Focused static scanner tests and governance import smokes passed for the changed scanner boundary.

negative_control_test.evidence: Live consumers named in W4 no longer contain WINDSURF_SCRIPTS_DIR; the deprecated alias remains only for compatibility and explicit path-constant coverage.

platform_approval_test.evidence: The active platform_core_change plan explicitly owns W4/P4.1-P4.2 and records W4 completion.

boundary_preservation_test.evidence: Static scanner non-structural scan roots include GOVERNANCE_SCRIPTS_DIR and the deprecated alias points to the same neutral value.

contract_compatibility_test.evidence: WINDSURF_SCRIPTS_DIR remains exported as a deprecated compatibility alias while live consumers move to GOVERNANCE_SCRIPTS_DIR.

runtime_proof_compatibility_test.evidence: Direct CI gate execution succeeded after both gates bootstrap the current repo root before importing path constants.
